hooks.name: Docs twin nudge after every file write
hooks.description: After fs_write, fs_append, str_replace or delete_file: if the path is under src/, infra/, policies/, evals/, scripts/, agentcore.json, pyproject.toml, docs/en or docs/el, prints which documents must be updated in the same turn in BOTH docs/en and docs/el (tool contracts, policy set, scenario catalogue, STATUS, decision log, or the language twin). Silent for other paths. De-duplicated per path per turn.

hooks.name: Bilingual docs sync check at end of turn
hooks.description: At the end of a turn: (1) if files under src/, infra/, policies/, evals/, scripts/, agentcore.json or pyproject.toml are newer than README.md, docs/ and the marker .kiro/.docs-sync-last, asks the agent to update the related docs in both languages; (2) checks EN/EL parity: every docs/en/X.md has a docs/el/X.md and vice versa, Greek not older than English, same counts of headings, table rows, checkboxes and code fences. Emits a block decision at most once per identical set of findings, so it cannot loop.
